text:
sam_infra: alert from eu-north dedicated pool — 95% GPU saturation across p3x-large pool, queue depth spiking, autoscaler not triggering. logs: `runner: oom? mem_frag=82% queue=420`
olivia_platform: seeing the same in console, metrics show per-node avg_util=0.92 and kernel_errors rising. any recent deploys to that pool?
ravi_oncall: oncall here, I got paged. checking recent evictions and kernel dumps. grabbing node list now.
eva_sre: infra-bot reported a network flurry from instance group eu-north-3 at 1791001000, connections dropped ~30s then recovered, could be causing backlog.
sam_infra: interesting — fixed scheduling wasn't enough because lots of long-lived KV cache sessions pinned GPUs. customers with pinned capacity hit first.
infra-bot: [incident] DedicatedPoolController: scale_request throttled (rate_limit=5/min) -> pending 12 -> backlog 410.
mike_prodops: if autoscaler rate limited, can we bump it temporarily? cost implications but we need to buy time. tagging finance later.
olivia_platform: I can temporarily relax rate limit and allow 10 more nodes to provision in eu-north-1/2 if capacity available. pinging cloud team to confirm spot vs on-demand.
ravi_oncall: before scaling, can we offload lower-tier traffic to hosted API? route policy exists: route -> hosted when pool_util>0.9 but it didn't trigger due to 'pinned customer' exception. we could add a temporary override.
eva_sre: agree. propose two-step: (1) emergency route override for non-pinned requests -> hosted, (2) lift autoscaler throttle to provision 6 nodes for pinned customers, (3) monitor for kernel errors.
sam_infra: how do we implement the override quickly? can we change routing policy via api?
olivia_platform: yes, run: `POST /admin/routing/overrides -d '{"scope":"eu-north","match":"!pinned","target":"hosted","duration":"30m"}'` — I'll run it if ops approves.
mike_prodops: approve the override. cost: estimate ~+$1.8k/hr while active. confirm with finance afterward.
ravi_oncall: running the change now.
deploy-bot: routing override applied by ravi_oncall at 1791001253 — scope=eu-north match=!pinned target=hosted duration=30m
sam_infra: confirm traffic shift? metrics show request_success still good, latency stable +15ms. awesome.
eva_sre: autoscaler throttle lifted by olivia_platform at 1791001278 — provisioning 6 nodes (on-demand). ETA ~4m.
infra-bot: new nodes registering: eu-north-node-198, eu-north-node-199 (2/6).
ravi_oncall: node health checks passing. queue depth dropped from 420->120 in 90s. pinned customer backlog still there but improving.
olm: (reaction) :thumbsup:
sam_infra: kernel_errors count still slowly climbing on a few older nodes. opening a follow-up: will schedule a rolling reboot of nodes with frag>80%.
eva_sre: I'll own the node reboots during quiet window, and coordinate with olivia to avoid interfering with provisioning.
mike_prodops: customers getting routed to hosted — double-check rate limits & quotas so we don't throttle user-facing production unexpectedly.
olivia_platform: increased hosted quota allowances for the override scope for 30m.
sam_infra: summary for CC: temporary routing override applied for non-pinned traffic, autoscaler throttle lifted for pinned customers, 6 nodes provisioning, queue reduced, monitoring kernels. will update in an hour or when situation resolved.
ravi_oncall: creating incident ticket and linking logs: INC-2026-1791. assigned to eng-infra and eng-runtime.
eva_sre: noted. I'll post a short blurb in #incidents once we have confirmation it's stable.
mike_prodops: thanks all — keep an eye on cost and make sure we rollback the override when pressure eases.
sam_infra: confirmed. closing thread when metrics back to normal.
